# Scope

This report fits the study's BART outcome model using
`synthetic_demo/data/synthetic_validation_data.csv`. It explicitly excludes
any `asd_flag` column. Because the input does not provide a label for this
demonstration, a separate outcome is simulated from maternal age, sex, and
`anom_downs`. The simulated outcome and the diagnostics are only a pipeline
check; they are not observed ASD status or clinical validation.

For a reproducible, shorter run, at most 10,000 rows are sampled from the input.
The BART settings are reduced from the primary analysis settings. Diagnostic
files are written under `../outputs/diagnostics/reference/20261019`.

# Fit model and save diagnostics

```{r}
seed <- 20261019L
set.seed(seed)

# Use the study directory as the working directory whether rendering from the
# repository root or directly from study_1.
if (!file.exists(file.path("R", "model_diagnostics.R"))) {
  if (file.exists(file.path("wadsi", "study_1", "R", "model_diagnostics.R"))) {
    setwd(file.path("wadsi", "study_1"))
  } else {
    stop("Run this report from the repository root or the study_1 directory.")
  }
}

required_packages <- c("readr", "dbarts", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "posterior", "knitr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop("Install required R packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}

source(file.path("R", "model_diagnostics.R"))

input_path <- file.path("synthetic_demo", "data", "synthetic_validation_data.csv")
if (!file.exists(input_path)) {
  stop("Synthetic input file not found: ", input_path)
}

synthetic_data <- readr::read_csv(
  input_path,
  na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL"),
  col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_guess()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
names(synthetic_data) <- tolower(names(synthetic_data))
if (anyDuplicated(names(synthetic_data))) {
  stop("Input has duplicate column names after case normalization.")
}

# Exclude any observed label before selecting features or simulating the demo
# outcome; it is never used for fitting, sampling, or diagnostics.
synthetic_data <- dplyr::select(
  synthetic_data,
  -dplyr::any_of("asd_flag")
)

candidate_features <- c(
  "mother_pre_preg_bmi", "mother_age", "mother_hispanic_ethnicity",
  "mother_bridged_race_eth_cd", "mother_edcode", "marital_status_nm",
  "father_age", "father_edcode", "father_hispanic_ethnicity",
  "father_bridged_race_eth_cd", "sex", "mother_wt_gain_loss",
  "mother_cig_use_flag", "mother_cig_prev_cig", "mother_cig_first_cig",
  "mother_cig_second_cig", "mother_cig_last_cig", "mother_cig_second_hand",
  "prenatal_yesno", "mth_prenat_care_beg", "prenat_tot_visits",
  "live_births_living", "live_births_dead", "live_birth_order",
  "inter_preg_interval", "mr_none", "mr_diab", "mr_diab_gest",
  "mr_hypert_chronic", "mr_hypert_preg", "mr_eclampsia",
  "mr_infertility_drugs", "mr_infertility_tech", "mr_prev_cesarean_yesno",
  "mr_prev_ces_numb", "mr_unknown", "inf_any", "inf_none", "inf_syphilis",
  "inf_chlamydia", "inf_hepatitis_b", "inf_hepatitis_c", "inf_unknown",
  "ob_none", "ob_tocolysis", "ob_unknown", "cld_none", "cld_premature_rom",
  "cld_precip_labor", "cld_prolong_labor", "cld_unknown", "char_none",
  "char_induction", "char_non_vertex", "char_antibiotic", "char_chorioamnio",
  "char_meconium", "char_fetal_intolerance", "char_epidural", "char_unknown",
  "fetal_presentation", "final_route_method_deliv", "prev_ces_plus_method_route",
  "mm_none", "mm_transfusion", "mm_ruptured_uterus", "mm_unknown",
  "birth_weight_grams", "apgar_5", "obst_est_gest", "oe_gestation_weeks",
  "plurality", "ac_none", "ac_nicu", "ac_antibiotic_sepsis", "ac_unknown",
  "anom_none", "anom_downs", "anom_dow_karyo_confirm", "anom_dow_karyo_pending",
  "anom_chrom", "anom_chr_karyo_confirm", "anom_chr_karyo_pending", "anom_unknown"
)
feature_names <- setdiff(intersect(candidate_features, names(synthetic_data)), "asd_flag")
required_simulation_features <- c("mother_age", "sex", "anom_downs")
missing_features <- setdiff(required_simulation_features, feature_names)
if (length(missing_features) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Cannot generate the synthetic outcome; required predictors are missing: ",
    paste(missing_features, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
if (length(feature_names) == 0L) {
  stop("No configured predictors were found in the synthetic input.")
}

as_numeric <- function(values) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(values)))
}

age <- as_numeric(synthetic_data$mother_age)
age_center <- mean(age, na.rm = TRUE)
age_scale <- stats::sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)
if (!is.finite(age_center) || !is.finite(age_scale) || age_scale == 0) {
  stop("mother_age must have at least two distinct observed numeric values.")
}
age_z <- (age - age_center) / age_scale
age_z[!is.finite(age_z)] <- 0
male <- as.integer(
  toupper(trimws(as.character(synthetic_data$sex))) %in% c("M", "MALE")
)
downs <- as_numeric(synthetic_data$anom_downs)
downs[!is.finite(downs)] <- 0
synthetic_probability <- stats::plogis(
  -3.6 + 0.45 * male + 0.2 * age_z + 0.8 * downs
)
outcome_name <- "synthetic_outcome"
set.seed(seed)
synthetic_data[[outcome_name]] <- stats::rbinom(
  nrow(synthetic_data),
  size = 1L,
  prob = synthetic_probability
)

categorical_features <- intersect(
  feature_names,
  c(
    "mother_hispanic_ethnicity", "mother_bridged_race_eth_cd", "mother_edcode",
    "marital_status_nm", "father_edcode", "father_hispanic_ethnicity",
    "father_bridged_race_eth_cd", "sex", "mother_cig_use_flag",
    "mother_cig_prev_cig", "mother_cig_first_cig", "mother_cig_second_cig",
    "mother_cig_last_cig", "mother_cig_second_hand", "prenatal_yesno",
    "mth_prenat_care_beg", "fetal_presentation", "final_route_method_deliv",
    "prev_ces_plus_method_route", "plurality"
  )
)
categorical_features <- union(
  categorical_features,
  feature_names[grepl("^(mr|inf|ob|cld|char|mm|ac|anom)_", feature_names)]
)
unclassified_text <- feature_names[vapply(
  synthetic_data[feature_names],
  is.character,
  logical(1)
)]
unclassified_text <- setdiff(unclassified_text, categorical_features)
if (length(unclassified_text) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Classify these text predictors as categorical before fitting: ",
    paste(unclassified_text, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

set.seed(seed + 1L)
analysis_rows <- if (nrow(synthetic_data) > 10000L) {
  sample.int(nrow(synthetic_data), 10000L)
} else {
  seq_len(nrow(synthetic_data))
}
analysis_data <- synthetic_data[analysis_rows, , drop = FALSE]

numeric_medians <- list()
factor_levels <- list()
prepare_features <- function(data) {
  prepared <- data[, feature_names, drop = FALSE]
  for (name in feature_names) {
    values <- prepared[[name]]
    if (name %in% categorical_features) {
      values <- as.character(values)
      values[is.na(values) | !nzchar(values)] <- "__MISSING__"
      observed_levels <- sort(setdiff(unique(values), "__MISSING__"))
      factor_levels[[name]] <<- c(observed_levels, "__MISSING__")
      prepared[[name]] <- factor(values, levels = factor_levels[[name]])
    } else {
      numeric_values <- as_numeric(values)
      observed <- numeric_values[is.finite(numeric_values)]
      if (length(observed) == 0L) {
        stop("Numeric predictor has no observed values: ", name)
      }
      numeric_medians[[name]] <<- stats::median(observed)
      numeric_values[!is.finite(numeric_values)] <- numeric_medians[[name]]
      prepared[[name]] <- numeric_values
    }
  }
  prepared
}

x_train <- prepare_features(analysis_data)
analytic_df <- x_train
analytic_df[[outcome_name]] <- analysis_data[[outcome_name]]
y_train <- analytic_df[[outcome_name]]

nchain <- 2L
ndpost <- 100L
diagnostics_path <- file.path(
  "..", "outputs", "diagnostics", "reference", as.character(seed)
)
dir.create(diagnostics_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Input:", normalizePath(input_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Source rows:", nrow(synthetic_data), "\n")
cat("Rows used:", nrow(analytic_df), "\n")
cat("Predictors:", length(feature_names), "\n")
cat("Simulated outcome prevalence:", mean(y_train), "\n")
cat("Seed:", seed, "\n")
cat("Diagnostics directory:", normalizePath(diagnostics_path, winslash = "/"), "\n")

bart_fit <- dbarts::bart(
  x.train = x_train,
  y.train = y_train,
  keeptrees = FALSE,
  keeptrainfits = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  nchain = nchain,
  nthread = 2L,
  nskip = 100L,
  ndpost = ndpost,
  keepevery = 1L,
  seed = seed
)

diag_results <- model_diagnostics(
  bart_fit = bart_fit,
  analytic_df = analytic_df,
  outcome_var = outcome_name,
  save_path = diagnostics_path,
  nchain = nchain,
  ndpost = ndpost
)
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    metric = c("Brier score", "Negative log probability"),
    value = c(diag_results$brier_score, diag_results$negative_log_probability)
  ),
  digits = 5,
  caption = "In-sample diagnostics on the simulated synthetic outcome."
)
```

# Diagnostic plots

```{r}
diag_results$plots$trace
```

diag_results$plots$calib
